title: Yu Yu Hakusho
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Teen delinquent Yusuke Urameshi dies pushing a child out of a car's path, and Koenma, son of the ruler of the afterlife, lets him earn his way back to life. Revived as a Spirit Detective, Yusuke investigates demons in the human world with friends Kuwabara, Kurama and Hiei, fights through the Dark Tournament, stops his predecessor Sensui's plan to wipe out humanity, and learns he is part demon himself.
life_message: It holds up selfless courage, friendship and growing up through hard tests of character.
